The growth of this town is much more inspiring to me
I need to speak with Ace, that doesn't make any sense.
Getting books shipped out here isn't cheap, I need that money!
Why do you like gardening so much? Isn't it a little tedious?
Have you met any Ribbits yet? They fascinate me...
dialog.npc.market.chatter_friendship3.11: The night is so beautiful and harsh out here.
dialog.npc.market.chatter_friendship3.12: She's not an easy person to talk to, but she's very well connected.
dialog.npc.market.chatter_friendship3.13: If everything is permitted, why does Caroline bother me so?
dialog.npc.market.chatter_friendship3.14: Can't wait to get my package. What's taking them so long?
Maybe I should talk to Caroline... Just to check.
dialog.npc.market.chatter_friendship3.15: Have you spoke to Caroline today?
Did she say anything about my behavior? I really hope not.
Just curious, I don't think it matters either way.
Caroline hasn't been around in a while...
I hope that means I'm doing alright here.
Have you ever been to Emporio? Or did you not get out much back then.
I miss all my old friends, have they moved on by now?
dialog.npc.market.chatter_friendship4.10: When it rains I feel this sense of dread, as if it's washing away my protective coating.
dialog.npc.market.chatter_friendship4.11: I've been missing the comforts of living in a big city.
Everything is so slow around here! I don't have the patience for it.
dialog.npc.market.chatter_friendship4.12: I've been dying to talk to someone lately.
You'd think people would be coming by here more often...
dialog.npc.market.chatter_friendship4.13: Has Haruna taken a trip to the Ocean recently?
I gave her some film for the beach to take photos but I'm guessing she forgot about it.
...But I'm always happy to see you @i!
Have you had a visit yet?
I wonder if she has a soft side...
Is my only task in this short life to sort products?
I could use a cold glass of wine right about now.
Have you had the time to go out exploring yet?
I'm sure there's some tasty things out there I haven't tried.
The best thing about living out here is the freshness of everything
I never realized blueberries had such strong flavor!
I wonder, are Magic Shears ethical?
I'm sure if they weren't Maria wouldn't sell them...
I'd much rather you exploit nature than other people.
Nature always gets its revenge, while the weak have no advocates.
Caroline visited me the other day! She seemed happy with our sales this season.
Please don't let me disappoint her!
dialog.npc.market.chatter_friendship5.10: Caroline has really relaxed lately, have you been sweet talking her?
dialog.npc.market.chatter_friendship5.11: Were you ever much of a reader before moving here
Literature can be inspiring, it's the frontier of the mind after all.
dialog.npc.market.chatter_friendship5.12: Have you started making wine yet?
I could use some of that about now...
dialog.npc.market.chatter_friendship5.13: Found any interesting wild crops lately?
I could use something fun to eat.
dialog.npc.market.gift_loved.0.line_1: I'm very thankful you're part of the melange.
dialog.npc.market.gift_loved.4.line_0: Nobody around here would know I like this. Am I really that fascinating to you?
dialog.npc.market.gift_loved.5.line_0: To love someone means to see them as Selene intended them.
dialog.npc.market.gift_loved.6.line_0: This is a fine gift from a finer person!
dialog.npc.market.gift_loved.7.line_0: Aesthetically perfect. A work of art.
dialog.npc.market.gift_loved.8.line_0: I can't stop looking at it...
dialog.npc.market.gift_loved.8.line_1: How on earth did you get your hands on this...
dialog.npc.market.gift_loved.9.line_0: It is the ultimate respect to receive a masterwork from someone at the height of their craft.
dialog.npc.market.gift_liked.2.line_1: No that's not right. I like this way more.
dialog.npc.market.gift_liked.3.line_0: You're very appreciated, I hope you know.
dialog.npc.market.gift_liked.4.line_0: The margins on seeds aren't great, little luxuries like this go a long way!
dialog.npc.market.gift_liked.6.line_0: Thank you, I really needed the pick-me-up!
dialog.npc.market.gift_liked.7.line_0: It's been so slow today, finally something nice happened!
dialog.npc.market.gift_neutral.3.line_0: Are you handing these out to everyone?
dialog.npc.market.gift_neutral.4.line_0: It looks high quality but it's not really to my taste.
dialog.npc.market.gift_neutral.5.line_0: In a way, something this ugly has a certain beauty to it! Exciting!
dialog.npc.market.gift_neutral.6.line_0: I do love a gift! Even if its not quite one I want!
dialog.npc.market.gift_neutral.7.line_0: I'm not really sure how to react to this but thank you for the kindness.
dialog.npc.market.gift_neutral.8.line_0: I have plenty of random objects for still life at my shop, but thank you!
dialog.npc.market.gift_neutral.9.line_0: If you keep giving me things you'll eventually find one I actually like!
dialog.npc.market.gift_neutral.10.line_1: Life is lived in the details, and you need to pay more attention!
dialog.npc.market.gift_neutral.13.line_0: You could have put a little more thought into this.
dialog.npc.market.gift_neutral.14.line_0: I don't hate this for some reason.
dialog.npc.market.gift_neutral.15.line_0: Are you even listening to me when I speak to you?
dialog.npc.market.gift_neutral.16.line_0: Someone around here will definitely like this, I'm sure.
dialog.npc.market.gift_disliked.0.line_1: I thought that was just your look...
dialog.npc.market.gift_disliked.4.line_0: I don't really want that. Or need it.
dialog.npc.market.gift_disliked.5.line_0: You can be sincere and still be...
dialog.npc.market.gift_disliked.6.line_0: Let's be real I'm just gonna toss this when you walk away.
dialog.npc.market.gift_disliked.7.line_0: Oh! I'm actually really busy right now.
dialog.npc.market.gift_disliked.7.line_1: Some seeds ran away, I really need to catch them?
dialog.npc.market.gift_disliked.8.line_0: Be real with me are you just pulling random stuff from your pocket to give to me?
dialog.npc.market.gift_disliked.9.line_0: Woah! I don't really want this!
dialog.npc.market.gift_disliked.10.line_: I don't like things like this.
dialog.npc.market.gift_hated.3.line_0: A beast can never be as cruel as a human being, so artistically, so picturesquely cruel.
dialog.npc.market.gift_hated.4.line_0: I hope you aren't this inept at farming.
dialog.npc.market.gift_hated.5.line_0: When you look in the mirror at night, think of all that is wasted on you.
dialog.npc.market.gift_hated.6.line_0: You are senseless and I don't enjoy you.
dialog.npc.market.gift_hated.7.line_0: What kind of person do you take me for?
dialog.npc.market.gift_hated.8.line_0: It takes something more than intelligence to act intelligently.
dialog.npc.market.gift_hated.9.line_0: I deserve better than to be treated like this.
dialog.npc.market.gift_hated.12.line_0: You are a child, get away from me.
dialog.npc.market.unique_five_gift.line_: Ahhh just the person I wanted to see today! I have a bit of a request for you.
Caroline's making me read this really dry book on farming, and I really can't be bothered...
But you're a farmer! A really good one at that, and I'd know more than anyone else here.
Sooooo.... Can you please read this book for me and give me a quick summary on it?
In return I'll convince Caroline to let me carry seeds of every season all the time!
It's a win win but I know you'd do it either way since you seem absolutely infatuated with me.
Hey @i, you look like the type of person who's read Universal Methods of Farming, am I right?
Sorry I don't mean to call you a nerd. I mean you definitely are a farming nerd there's no doubt about that.
But I digress and I'll cut to the chase. Can you give me a quick summary on it?
Caroline's making me read this really dry book on farming, and I really can't be bothered...
I'll give you some of these rare sparkpod seeds in advance, it really is a win win!
Although... I know you'd do it either way since you seem absolutely infatuated with me.
dialog.npc.blacksmith.chatter_friendship: They're so delicate and graceful...
I wonder if Caroline can hook her up with a different supplier?
Some people can really take advantage of you if you're not careful.
It's a beautiful day today.
Hmmm nobody seems to be buying pitchforks at Leon's.
Or maybe a certain someone forgot to put in an order again...
How are you doing today? It's a beautiful day out!
It's crazy how many tools Ace seems to go through every week!
Everyone here has been working so hard!
...Except maybe Leon...
Ace told me more about the Skull Cavern last night...
Apparently the desert caves are full of gold and iridium!
Also
I was taking a walk the other day and noticed a Limpet staring at me from a cave!
What a cute little snail!
Caroline refuses to go with any other suppliers for the stuff I make.
I guess I should take that as a compliment but that's more work for me...
Did you hear what Leon was saying about Caroline?
Actually I shouldn't spread rumors, talk to Leon yourself about it.
What do you think about Haruna? I can't tell if she's closed off or just quiet...
I wonder what Caroline is doing with all that gold she ordered recently.
Heya @i! What do you need!
Welcome back, I've been missing you!
When I feel homesick I think of all the wonderful people around me.
You're included on that list of course!
Hmmm Leon still owes me for fixing that shelf... I wonder if I can get something sweet today at the market!
Ugh, I slept on my neck oddly last night...
But seeing you has made the day worth it!
Leon gave me a free bouquet with my groceries today!
I feel a bit guilty for mistaking nonchalance for rudness.
You smell like roses! Have you been exploring the flower forests recently?
I've heard you can find rainbow trees there, but that seems a little ridiculous to me.
Sometimes when I'm working I'll catch a little but of Haruna's singing! It's so serene out here...
I'm really glad I came out, life has been so rich for me lately.
♫ Heya hiya @i! ♫
I always get a little self-conscious when Caroline's auditing my stock.
She can be harsh sometimes but it always seems to come from a good place.
You should get around to finishing the boiler room if you haven't already.
Nothing wrong with some industrial machinery to make farm life easier!
I'm starting to come around to Leon I think.
Some people are just rough around the edges due to circumstances in their lives.
Though I'm not quite sure if that's true of Leon...
People think that smithing is all about strength, but it's more to it than that.
Rare metals like neptunium or electrum require more gentle presses.
Every type of metal has its own personality!
Welcome welcome! Always have time for a friend.
♫ It's a new day! A fresh start! A glowing morning! ♫
Sparkstone is such a curious thing. It's the distilled essence of the moon, a gift of Selene.
Have you gotten your hands on some silver?
It's exceedingly rare, but electrum tools can make your mining trips more fruitful!
Ace gave me some mossberries from yesterday's chopping run! They're so pleasantly tangy!
I love the fresh smell of the valley, they remind me of spring magnolias from my home town.
Leon has started waving to me regularly! Does this mean what I think it does?
Have you upgraded your tools to iridium yet?
Ace was telling me it's more plentiful on the lower depths of the Skull Cavern!
I would love to get my hands on a prismatic shard...
The Skull Cavern is far too dangerous for a person like me to traverse!
Maria made me this perfect sweater for these harsh winters!
Too bad it's a little small for me, but at least it's nice to look at!
Leon said something nice to me!
Well maybe it was nice, I'm not quite sure.
But it at least felt good to hear!
dialog.npc.blacksmith.gift_loved.2.line_: But it would be rude not to!
dialog.npc.blacksmith.gift_loved.3.line_: I'm going to cry, this is too sweet just to jump a person with!
dialog.npc.blacksmith.gift_loved.4.line_: How did you know I've been wanting one of these! You're too kind!
dialog.npc.blacksmith.gift_loved.5.line_: Woah! @i I didn't know you liked me that much... Thank you!
dialog.npc.blacksmith.gift_loved.6.line_: What have I done to deserve such a sweet friend!! Thank you so much!
dialog.npc.blacksmith.gift_loved.7.line_: You can't just walk up to someone and give them a gift like this!
dialog.npc.blacksmith.gift_liked.2.line_: What!! A gift like this! Thank you!
dialog.npc.blacksmith.gift_liked.3.line_: That's so sweet of you... Thanks truly!
dialog.npc.blacksmith.gift_liked.5.line_: You're a really good friend @i, thank you!
dialog.npc.blacksmith.gift_liked.6.line_: It's so nice to feel appreciated here!
dialog.npc.blacksmith.gift_liked.8.line_: You're such a kind person... Thank you @i.
dialog.npc.blacksmith.gift_neutral.5.lin: I think I can use this for something!
dialog.npc.blacksmith.gift_neutral.6.lin: Oh! Thank you for the gift.
dialog.npc.blacksmith.gift_neutral.7.lin: It's nice to be thought about.
dialog.npc.blacksmith.gift_disliked.2.li: I appreciate the thought but you should really know me better!
It's an important mark of a friend.
dialog.npc.blacksmith.gift_disliked.4.li: This isn't really to my taste but that's alright!
dialog.npc.blacksmith.gift_disliked.5.li: Oh! A gift! This is a gift right?
dialog.npc.blacksmith.gift_disliked.6.li: I don't think I can melt this down into anything usable if that's what your asking...
dialog.npc.blacksmith.gift_disliked.7.li: I can never be too mad at someone for trying to do something nice.
dialog.npc.blacksmith.gift_hated.2.line_: This isn't how you treat a friend.
dialog.npc.blacksmith.gift_hated.3.line_: Did I upset you? What's going on here...
dialog.npc.blacksmith.gift_hated.6.line_: I wish I didn't have better expectations of you.
dialog.npc.blacksmith.gift_hated.7.line_: Talk to me again when you're in a better mood.
If you continue to take your anger out on the people of this town I won't forgive you.
dialog.npc.blacksmith.gift_hated.8.line_: Why would you give me such a thing...
dialog.npc.blacksmith.gift_hated.9.line_: I can never be too mad at someone for trying to do something nice...
But this feels a little mean-spirited
dialog.npc.blacksmith.unique_five_gift.l: Oh hey hey hey it's my best friend @i!! I've got something that'll make your day even brighter!
A special edition of my mining specialty mining hammer, on the house!
I'm sure you're moving tons of stone while building out this town, so this should really help speed up your work.
Oh right by the way, I didn't exactly clear this with Caroline, so don't go showing it off to her. You know how much she cares about our budgets...
When you choose a name for your animals, it creates a special bond between you and them.
Make sure you name them something that fits their personality!
How are things on your farm?
Everything is so calm and simple around here...
I'm excited to see how things change over time.
Ace gave me some Salmonberries to munch on today!
No wonder I see squirrels digging around for them all the time.
Feel free to stop by if you have any questions about animals.
Hey @i, what can I do for you?
Everybody lies, but animals will always tell you the truth.
Except racoons, those always try and trick you!
How is Aiden so cheerful standing in that heat all day?
Why did Leon even move out here?
I've never met someone that hates nature more.
I miss the stray cats of the city I grew up in...
Stray sheep are a different kind of nice though!
All these new people in town...
Moving to a new town sure is rough.
I've seen some nasty farmers out there that treat their animals cruelly.
Giant holding pens stuffed to the brim... Makes me sick...
I'm glad you're not like that!
Running low on animal feed?
Or are you here to adopt!
I've been loving seeing all the wild animals run around freely lately.
There's something about the air here that's so freeing.
I hope you're feeding your animals every day.
You'd be grumpy to if you had to skip a meal!
You should see if you can make a Catching Net!
There's so many wonderful butterflies around the valley.
I don't have the heart to garden, all my plants always end up over-watered...
I love the feeling of weaving on a Canvas Loom.
There's nothing quite like it.
Leon was so sour today when I went to get groceries.
People can be so mean when they're tired.
People's hearts are often unveiled with their treatment of animals.
Some people can be so disappointing in life.
Ahh but nobody here is like that! Probably...
Grains like Wheat and Corn can be made into Animal Feed.
I'm sure your animals will appreciate fresher food than what I've got!
Need more feed?
Have you considered ranching pigs?
Truffles are great for making donuts!
Have you talked to Aiden recently?
I really need that order of pails...
Animals have no concept of the evils we are capable of.
It's our job to make sure they never find out.
You can tell a lot about a person by the way they approach a scared animal.
I was reading about Minisheep today in the farmer's almanac.
...So fluffy...
Caroline is a sucker for goat cheese.
Don't mention I said that! I want to know more secrets...
Leon has sewing supplies stocked at the market.
Let me know if you need lessons!
Caroline has some expensive taste.
Most people don't have an eye for proper merino wool.
Your hands are so calloused!
Let me take a look later, I have a serum made from sheeps milk that will help.
Do you ever think about what our animals dream about?
Someone like you could really use some pets.
I bet it gets lonely over where you are.
Originally I thought Leon disliked me in particular.
Turns out they're just like that.
There's nothing as sweet as the love of an animal.
Hey @i, what are you up to today?
How's your ranch going today?
You sure like spending time with me.
Or maybe you have some sort of ulterior motive...
You really have no rhythm when talking to me.
I never know when to expect you.
I wonder if building out this town effects your ego in any way.
People here will always keep you humble I bet!
Caroline can be so mean!
It's one of the more frustrating things of living here.
There's so much to industrial farming that I dislike.
I understand the realities of keeping society going...
Just don't mistreat animals, I'll know.
There's a myth around farmers that having too many animals will incur the wrath of Selene.
She's so real...
Have you heard about goobers?
I've heard they're native place called the Skull Cavern, wherever that is.
Ace was telling me about mossberries the other day.
I bet they'd make a great jam.
People around here will just come up to me and tell me their secrets.
I guess I look trusting to them?
I've been knitting some sweaters for the harsh winters around here.
Not that you need one for all that running around you do every day!
Leon let me sample some of your animal products the other day.
Everything was so fresh and full of flavor!
Leon sure likes talking about Caroline.
I wonder what that's about...
People sometimes think that I don't like people just because I have a love of animals.
I'm glad you're not one of them
Ahh! I was looking for you @i.
What's on your schedule @i?
What can I do for you?
Some people think they can win me over with gifts and small talk.
That's not a real connection, and you know that.
You've really got an eye for getting to know people.
You're very easy to talk to so it makes sense.
The way a shima enaga tilts its tiny head is a wonder of the world.
Truly a snow fairy!
What a calm day today...
What would you like?
People think pigs are monsters for what people force them to eat.
Animals teach us so much about humanity.
Ace wants to see you about something.
I wonder what you to talk about when nobody's looking.
I knew I'd see you today, I stocked some extra feed ahead of time!
Caroline isn't one of those people that's a sweetheart once you get to know them.
Usually I'm right about these things.
Your ambitions are so frightening to me...
I hope pulling up the roots of this valley is worth whatever you're trying to accomplish.
There's something so nice about the way an animal looks at you with loving eyes.
Nothing quite like it.
dialog.npc.shepherd.gift_loved.2.line_0: This is one of my favorites!
dialog.npc.shepherd.gift_loved.3.line_0: What a sweet gift, thank you @i.
dialog.npc.shepherd.gift_loved.4.line_0: This makes me feel very welcome here.
dialog.npc.shepherd.gift_loved.5.line_0: How'd you know I love these?
dialog.npc.shepherd.gift_liked.1.line_0: I know the perfect spot for this!
dialog.npc.shepherd.gift_liked.2.line_0: I was looking for this at the market the other day! How'd you know?
dialog.npc.shepherd.gift_liked.4.line_0: Is this from your farm? This is lovely.
dialog.npc.shepherd.gift_liked.5.line_0: This is a very considerate gift.
dialog.npc.shepherd.gift_liked.8.line_0: It's so nice to have people like you here.
dialog.npc.shepherd.gift_neutral.2.line_: I think one of my friends would like this!
dialog.npc.shepherd.gift_neutral.4.line_: Is this from your farm? I've never seen one quite like this.
dialog.npc.shepherd.gift_disliked.1.line: You must know animals way better than people...
dialog.npc.shepherd.gift_disliked.2.line: Sometimes it's better to not give gifts.
dialog.npc.shepherd.gift_disliked.6.line: Did you mean to give this to someone else?
dialog.npc.shepherd.gift_disliked.7.line: We don't really have to give gifts to each other...
dialog.npc.shepherd.gift_hated.3.line_0: You can just ask me to leave directly.
dialog.npc.shepherd.gift_hated.5.line_0: This doesn't make me feel good...
dialog.npc.shepherd.gift_hated.6.line_0: I'm not sure I want this...
dialog.npc.shepherd.gift_hated.7.line_0: Can you leave me alone please.
dialog.npc.shepherd.gift_hated.8.line_0: I don't like these kinds of jokes.
dialog.npc.shepherd.gift_hated.9.line_0: Sorry but I really don't want this...
dialog.npc.shepherd.gift_hated.10.line_0: This might be the worst thing I've ever been given...
dialog.npc.shepherd.unique_five_gift.lin: Oh hello @i, I actually have a small favor for you!
Ace found these penguins out on an expedition to a frozen wasteland and told me to take care of them.
I don't mean to just shift the responsibility to you, but I really trust you to treat them with the care they deserve.
Unfortunately I don't have the means to build up a proper ice habitat, they wouldn't be happy with me.
If you're struggling with their mood, just pick up a mood scanner at my shop! It should be pretty cheap for you.
Stars fall all the time, such as I on new ground.
Hmmm? Apologies, I was lost in thought.
Ah, I was told I should sell you a fishing rod.
I also have some bait for sale if you pick up a tackle box as well.
Fishing is a serene joy that's best enjoyed on your own.
dialog.npc.fisher.chatter_friendship0.10: I'm fishing right now, if you could excuse me.
I wonder who is writing all these messages in bottles.
I hope they don't mind my curiosity.
Aiden might be the largest person I've ever seen. So tall...
Ace is an anomaly to me, such is a person I cannot read.
Where I come from, we use a lot more Neptunium.
A glow like the stars of home
There's many unique fish in these waters. I'd like to get acquainted with them.
If you're not great at fishing I recommend trying a cork bobber.
How can I help you today @i?
♫ My life, my love and my lady... ♫
♫ Take me by the hand, lead me to the land... ♫
I see Morana on the shimmer of the still ocean.
Rivers have their own beautiful bounties.
Ace told me about sea pancakes! I'd like to see them...
Leon is very honest, I like that in a person.
Where I come from, everyone is well versed in the ways of fish.
I have never met someone as bad at fishing as Ace...
Want to try some different bobbers? I have a wide variety of them.
♫ Letting the days go by, let the water hold me down... ♫
There's something about the waters in these lands...
It's as if the sun is rebelling against the magic of the waves
You can't let it distract you from your catch, though.
Caroline respects what I do, yet doesn't come around here often...
It's curious. Fresh fish can come from salt water or fresh water...
And to keep fish fresh, you can salt them.
Have you checked your fish ponds today?
Do you think Ace can do anything with all of this driftwood I've found?
The fish here can be... unusual.
Bait Makers are convenient, but steady hands catch the best fish.
The waves crash against the shore
Maria is too sweet to understand the natural cycle of life and death.
Folks work and play and harvest
Fishing really takes you to all sorts of places.
Beaches, rivers, glaciers, islands... even volcanoes.
The markets at sea are quite volatile, you know.
I used to make most of my money from bounties.
Where does all this jelly come from?
♫ The clatter and clank, goes from tank to tank! ♫
Always refreshing to hear from you.
It's a lovely day for fishing.
It's been a while since I've been out at sea.
This place is quite magnetic, I suppose.
Such a big valley, and so many fish to catch...
Woe is the fisher with the empty rod...
A sonnet of deepfish, the organ of the cavernous waters.
Sneep snorp... Sneep snorp... What a rhythm the name of a fish has.
I'm growing quite attached to Maria's love of animals. It's very endearing!
dialog.npc.fisher.chatter_friendship5.10: I always enjoy sharing some wine with Leon on colder nights.
dialog.npc.fisher.gift_loved.1.line_0: Little joys like these give me a reason to sing, @i.
dialog.npc.fisher.gift_loved.2.line_0: You know me all too well, you're a gem of the land.
dialog.npc.fisher.gift_loved.3.line_0: Truly this is a wonderful gift. It reminds me of home.
dialog.npc.fisher.gift_loved.4.line_0: Thank you @i. I feel very welcome here.
dialog.npc.fisher.gift_loved.6.line_0: Such kindness cannot be repaid by me, but it would be rude to not accept such a gift.
dialog.npc.fisher.gift_liked.2.line_0: Almost as sweet as the sound of evening waves.
dialog.npc.fisher.gift_liked.3.line_0: I appreciate this more than you'll know.
dialog.npc.fisher.gift_liked.4.line_0: You've got a knack for giving gifts @i.
dialog.npc.fisher.gift_liked.5.line_0: This is a brisk wind on a warm day, welcome and appreciated.
dialog.npc.fisher.gift_neutral.3.line_0: Hmmm do you think one of the others would like this as well?
dialog.npc.fisher.gift_neutral.4.line_0: I could use this as an offering for the stars, thank you.
dialog.npc.fisher.gift_neutral.5.line_0: I was looking to experiment with new kinds of bobbers, thank you.
dialog.npc.fisher.gift_neutral.7.line_0: It's strange, people here give me random things like this. I'm still not used to it.
dialog.npc.fisher.gift_neutral.8.line_0: I'm not sure what use I have for this but I appreciate the gesture.
dialog.npc.fisher.gift_disliked.1.line_0: Some things are better kept than given.
dialog.npc.fisher.gift_disliked.2.line_0: I'm not sure if I care for this...
dialog.npc.fisher.gift_disliked.3.line_0: In my culture, this is considered a "faux pas".
dialog.npc.fisher.gift_disliked.4.line_0: How I wish there were a shell I could be listening to right now.
dialog.npc.fisher.gift_disliked.5.line_0: I don't think I can even use this as bait...
dialog.npc.fisher.gift_disliked.6.line_0: Does this pass for a joke here?
dialog.npc.fisher.gift_hated.1.line_0: I wonder if it's safe to sail back home.
dialog.npc.fisher.gift_hated.3.line_0: Perhaps I should erect a "Gone Fishing" sign in my stead.
dialog.npc.fisher.gift_hated.4.line_0: How long did you think about this?
dialog.npc.fisher.gift_hated.6.line_0: Just because I like the sea doesn't mean I like sea garbage.
dialog.npc.fisher.unique_five_gift.line_: Hello @i, I have a small token of appreciation for you.
I haven't spent all that long in this land, yet you continue to treat me as if you've known me your entire life.
This pendant is a mystical relic from where I come from. Ancient magi would infuse it with neptunium to summon a giant sea-serpent.
Ahh, but don't worry about that! These waters are too mundane for it to have any use here.
Hopefully this brings you a tiny bit closer to understanding my soul.
dialog.npc.witch.chatter_friendship0.1.l: That's a lie actually, Caroline audits my books regularly...
dialog.npc.witch.chatter_friendship0.3.l: I didn't do it I swear, I bet Leon did it!
Oh? Caroline didn't send you? Nevermind then.
dialog.npc.witch.chatter_friendship0.4.l: Sorry, I don't do tarot readings. Not that kind of witch.
dialog.npc.witch.chatter_friendship0.5.l: * It appears that Evelyne is sleepwalking *
* Would be best to leave your payment somewhere nearby... *
dialog.npc.witch.chatter_friendship1.0.l: What have you found today? You aren't holding out on me right?
dialog.npc.witch.chatter_friendship1.1.l: Why do people keep secrets from me! Of all people!
dialog.npc.witch.chatter_friendship1.2.l: Sorry, I've been asking everyone that, I can't find my calendar...
dialog.npc.witch.chatter_friendship1.3.l: Maria is so annoying about getting those Miracle Potions restocked!
Who even needs that many animals!
dialog.npc.witch.chatter_friendship1.4.l: Found any weird bugs lately? I know a person that really likes weird bugs.
I really need a favor from them, but I don't want anyone asking questions.
dialog.npc.witch.chatter_friendship2.0.l: You don't know a thing @i. There are forces at work you cannot imagine.
dialog.npc.witch.chatter_friendship2.1.l: Caroline is so mean to me! Everybody dozes off during business meetings, they're boring!
dialog.npc.witch.chatter_friendship2.2.l: * You hear snoring as you approach. Evelyne is once again fast sleep while standing. *
dialog.npc.witch.chatter_friendship2.3.l: I'm a fountain of blood. In the shape of a girl...
I guess that makes you a bird? So they say of course.
dialog.npc.witch.chatter_friendship2.4.l: I've been studying the magic around here for a few seasons, there's definitely more to be found...
dialog.npc.witch.chatter_friendship2.5.l: There is a deeper magic in this valley, I can sense it and you can too.
dialog.npc.witch.chatter_friendship3.0.l: I don't know a thing!! There are forces at work I cannot imagine!!
dialog.npc.witch.chatter_friendship3.1.l: * You cannot tell if Evelyne is half asleep or about to yell strange things at you *
Hmmm? Why are you staring at me like that? Buy something.
dialog.npc.witch.chatter_friendship3.2.l: My plans are measured in centuries...
...But I cannot for the life of me remember where I put them...
dialog.npc.witch.chatter_friendship3.3.l: I thought I could organize my worktable.... How Scandinavian of me!
dialog.npc.witch.chatter_friendship3.4.l: Ace has been such a treasure for finding me herbs.
I actually realllly hate being out in nature so I can appreciate a person that does.
dialog.npc.witch.chatter_friendship3.5.l: Just because the mind can make up whatever it wants, doesn't mean that it'll never come true...
dialog.npc.witch.chatter_friendship3.6.l: I've made a break through last night! Normally I would tell you because we're friends and all but I think this one is a bit above your paygrade...
dialog.npc.witch.chatter_friendship3.7.l: Please buy something, I need to bribe Aiden into giving me some expensive mining equipment!
dialog.npc.witch.chatter_friendship4.0.l: That stupid moon lady keeps yelling at me in my sleep!
What's so wrong with hoarding? I might need this stuff again at some point!
dialog.npc.witch.chatter_friendship4.1.l: You haven't been shipping enough minerals lately, please don't tell me you're keeping them all for yourself...
dialog.npc.witch.chatter_friendship4.2.l: You shouldn't let poets lie to you!! And by poets I mean that Leon!!!
dialog.npc.witch.chatter_friendship4.3.l: I've seen it in a vision!
The crust of the Nether sinking to the bottom of the abyss, descending into the heavens!
Purified into crystline fields of agonizing brightness!
I'm certain it shall come to pass!
dialog.npc.witch.chatter_friendship4.4.l: Welcome back @i! I have your special order somewhere around here, let me fetch it...
Oh you didn't order anything? What am I supposed to do with 48 pounds of plorts?
dialog.npc.witch.chatter_friendship4.5.l: Carlos keeps trying to give me these raw deals! Who has the time to make that much Truffle Tea?
Why would anyone want that much?
dialog.npc.witch.chatter_friendship5.0.l: Moon lady and I are on better terms these days but I still think she's way more aggressive than she should be...
dialog.npc.witch.chatter_friendship5.1.l: Now that we're such good friends... Do you mind cleaning up around here for me? We're friends right?
dialog.npc.witch.chatter_friendship5.2.l: Did you know that in some worlds, people train bugs and dragons to fight against each other?
They let children do this, for money even!
dialog.npc.witch.chatter_friendship5.3.l: Can you tell Vernoica there's another typo in the 12 edition of 'Gneiss' Dictionary of Geology & Mineralogy'?
Honestly literature these days is in shambles, its embarrassing.
dialog.npc.witch.chatter_friendship5.4.l: Aiden keeps bringing me coffee every morning and I haven't figured out why...
Maybe we have another occult researcher on our hands!
dialog.npc.witch.gift_loved.2.line_0: This will keep me going for another few days, thank you @i.
dialog.npc.witch.gift_loved.3.line_0: Such a peculiar specimen... I think I'll keep it for my permanent collection.
dialog.npc.witch.gift_loved.4.line_0: I knew you weren't useless! Caroline was wrong! Thank you @i!
dialog.npc.witch.gift_liked.1.line_0: Who sent you? Do they know?
dialog.npc.witch.gift_liked.1.line_2: Oh give me that before you go, I kinda want it.
dialog.npc.witch.gift_liked.2.line_0: Hand it over, I can use that. I think.
dialog.npc.witch.gift_liked.3.line_0: Sorry I don't have any money right now.
dialog.npc.witch.gift_liked.3.line_1: Oh, you're just giving it to me? Just like that? Okay weirdo.
dialog.npc.witch.gift_liked.4.line_0: I can see why you would think this would be interesting to me.
dialog.npc.witch.gift_neutral.0.line_0: Oh I needed more of these.
dialog.npc.witch.gift_neutral.1.line_0: Just put that in the pile over there.
dialog.npc.witch.gift_neutral.2.line_0: Uhhhh I don't really research these types of things but I'm sure I could find a use for it!
dialog.npc.witch.gift_neutral.3.line_0: This is kinda boring, is this supposed to be for my research or a gift?
dialog.npc.witch.gift_neutral.3.line_1: Don't answer that, it's better that way.
dialog.npc.witch.gift_neutral.4.line_3: * You can't tell if Evelyne is studying the gift or has silently fallen asleep... *
dialog.npc.witch.gift_disliked.1.line_0: Oh I don't really need more cleaning supplies.
dialog.npc.witch.gift_disliked.2.line_0: I guess I could put this in my perpetual soup that kills people...
dialog.npc.witch.gift_disliked.2.line_1: ...You don't seriously believe I have one of those right? Go away.
dialog.npc.witch.gift_disliked.4.line_0: I think this is more Maria's speed if you know what I mean.
dialog.npc.witch.gift_hated.1.line_0: I don't have space to keep this.
dialog.npc.witch.gift_hated.2.line_0: Am I joke to you or something? Have some respect.
dialog.npc.witch.gift_hated.3.line_0: * You hear aggressively loud fake snoring. *
dialog.npc.witch.gift_hated.3.line_1: * It appears Evelyne does not want this. *
dialog.npc.witch.gift_hated.4.line_0: I really don't feel like throwing your garbage away for you.
dialog.npc.witch.gift_hated.5.line_0: Oh, why are you giving this to me? I don't want this.
dialog.npc.witch.unique_five_gift.line_0: Want to make Maria mad for me? Not for me actually, WITH ME.
dialog.npc.witch.unique_five_gift.line_1: Take this peculiar device and put it near your animals!
dialog.npc.witch.unique_five_gift.line_2: It's imbued with the power of the sun and makes your animals feel as though they've been pet!
dialog.npc.witch.unique_five_gift.line_3: Normally it's nearly impossible to get one of these things, but I reallly want to prove to Maria that cattle is cattle!
dialog.npc.witch.unique_five_gift.line_4: None of that 'love and affection' stuff! She's conning everyone and you will prove it!
dialog.npc.librarian.intro.0.line_4: Please stop by the next time you get the chance.
dialog.npc.librarian.chatter_friendship0: Make sure to check in during the end of the season, I have some rare books for sale then.
Welcome, what can I get you?
...Sorry I'm not good with small talk...
dialog.npc.librarian.chatter_friendship1: Back again? Have you been doing some more farm expansion?
Are you going to buy something this time or just give me 'that look' when I show you the prices again?
You should know what I'm here for by now, please have a look.
Evelyne was bragging to me about these magical drawers that teleport items between them...
What a rude person. It's not like I can sell *every* type of box out there.
Is your day going alright? It's been quiet out there.
dialog.npc.librarian.chatter_friendship2: How has Aiden managed to break so many of my storage crates? Are ingots being placed in them hot or something?
Have you seen a copy of Vōg Italia lying around anywhere?
I haven't had a chance to look at this season's collection yet...
What can I do for you today @i?
I'm getting food with Caroline soon so make it quick, I don't have much time.
I have no idea how to talk to that Ace.
I've never met someone that talks so fast, it's frustrating.
dialog.npc.librarian.chatter_friendship3: Some farmers prefer the more applied school of digital storage, though I find it overly complex.
Unfortunately, I only have enough room in my shop for the refined approach.
Don't forget to stop by every time I do the Book Fair! I can only stock so many books so some are seasonal!
Can you check in with Leon? I need that copy of 'Notebooks from Underneath' back, it's been weeks...
Ugh, this is the third nature field guide Ace has ruined this month! Annoying!
How can I help you today?
dialog.npc.librarian.chatter_friendship4: Evelyne has to be the most unorganized person I have ever met. It's embarrassing.
It breaks my heart that Caroline is so misunderstood...
Supporting towns like these require so much time, energy and resources to support.
It's very thankless work, most people flame out of it. But not my Caroline!
Caroline doesn't like when people are unprofessional, so keep our little chats when I'm on the clock between you and I.
Hey @i, what can I get you? You can't possibly need more space, right?
Get some minisheep! They have the most beautifully shininig coats. Their wool makes some gorgeous sweaters... ♡
Ah! Not that I'm an expert or anything! Ask Maria!
dialog.npc.librarian.chatter_friendship5: The key to making beautiful nit fabrics to do it by hand, this is something you should understand intuitively being a farmer and all.
Did you seen Iris von Harpten's latest collection??
I have no idea how she manages to use those strange materials to create such beautiful shapes... ♡
It's @i! I'm so happy to see you right now, Carolines been so busy this week and I need someone to talk to!
I wonder where Carlos sends all those random items you give him...
He's always asking for more shipping materials.
Oh hey @i! What can I get you today?
Fashion houses should never continue once their founding designers leave.
Yes I get that there are exceptions, but just look at Gaultiyay! It's become so gauche!
dialog.npc.librarian.gift_loved.1.line_0: Why would you show me a garment this beautiful, I could never get my hands on something like this...
dialog.npc.librarian.gift_loved.1.line_2: Thank you @i, I'll take perfect care of it, I have a spare garment bag and everything ♡
dialog.npc.librarian.gift_loved.2.line_0: How did you get your hands on something like this!?
dialog.npc.librarian.gift_loved.2.line_1: French seams like this are difficult to pull off on a garment of this size.
dialog.npc.librarian.gift_loved.2.line_2: It must have been made by someone who truly loves the craft ♡
dialog.npc.librarian.gift_loved.3.line_0: The texture of this is incredible, Maria must have taught you how to raise sheep with such kindness ♡
dialog.npc.librarian.gift_loved.4.line_0: What a wonderful gift, I can't wait to catalog this for my collection... ♡
dialog.npc.librarian.gift_liked.1.line_0: Thanks for the gift, small things like this go a long way.
dialog.npc.librarian.gift_liked.2.line_0: Oh! It's not so often I receive gifts, thank you.
dialog.npc.librarian.gift_liked.3.line_0: Do you need a special container for this? It seems nice.
dialog.npc.librarian.gift_liked.3.line_1: Oh this is for me? Thank you @i.
dialog.npc.librarian.gift_liked.4.line_0: Thank you for the gift, I know someone who'd love something like this.
dialog.npc.librarian.gift_neutral.1.line: I'll take care of this for you @i, when do you want it back?
dialog.npc.librarian.gift_neutral.2.line: Gift? Why do I need a gift?
dialog.npc.librarian.gift_neutral.3.line: I don't really do deliveries, that seems like Ace's type of thing.
dialog.npc.librarian.gift_neutral.4.line: Put that one on the pile back there please.
dialog.npc.librarian.gift_disliked.1.lin: I'm not a fan of things like this.
dialog.npc.librarian.gift_disliked.2.lin: Did you mean to give this to someone else? I don't understand...
dialog.npc.librarian.gift_disliked.3.lin: Can you give that to someone else? I don't really like it.
dialog.npc.librarian.gift_disliked.4.lin: I don't really have a need for this.
dialog.npc.librarian.gift_hated.1.line_0: What have I done to deserve your ire?
dialog.npc.librarian.gift_hated.2.line_0: I should let you know that I have to file a report for things like this.
dialog.npc.librarian.gift_hated.2.line_1: I'll let Caroline deal with you, please leave.
dialog.npc.librarian.gift_hated.4.line_0: If Aiden knew you gave people things like this, it would break his heart.
dialog.npc.librarian.unique_five_gift.li: Hey @i! I've got an idea on how to earn Caroline's respect!
As you've probably figured out right now, she's insatiable when it comes to your role in this little town.
It doesn't matter how much your farm makes, it will never be enough! Everyone around here relies on the economic activity of your farm after all.
That said, being knowledgeable about your financial history will give her at least a little more peace of mind.
It would be a shame if my two best friends didn't get along, so please read it when you get the chance ♡
dialog.npc.librarian.unique_five_gift_re: Hey @i! I've got another idea on how to earn Caroline's respect!
As you've probably figured out right now, she's insatiable when it comes to your role in this little town.
It doesn't matter how much your farm makes, it will never be enough! Everyone around here relies on the economic activity of your farm after all.
That said, not having to worry about you passing out in the Skull Cavern should give her a little more peace of mind.
It would be a shame if my two best friends didn't get along, so please make sure to wear these while you're down there ♡
dialog.npc.librarian.unique_book_fair.li: I have a selection of special books available for the book fair this season, please take a look.
dialog.npc.librarian.dialog.book_fair.li: I have a selection of special books available for the book fair this season, please take a look.
dialog.npc.trader.intro.0.line_4: I just am always tied up in the biz, you know how it is aha...
dialog.npc.trader.intro.0.line_6: Right right anyways, my name's Carlos! I only barter because some things are worth more than money can buy!
My stuff is top notch - just take a look!
I bet you've never seen this stuff before!
@i, was it? I've got lots of stock piled up just waiting for your purchase!
No money no problem! Just show me what those grubby hands have gotten ahold of!
I've got stuff you won't get anywhere else!
Always a pleasure doing business with you, @i.
Gotta keep something in the pack at all times!
It feels good to be in a right proper town. You can never get a good meal on the road!
Hello hello @i! What can I help you with today?
You got any Truffle Tea? I'd really like to get my hands on some...
Have you seen Ace around? I've got plenty o' rare saplings in my private stock!
Caroline was cooking up something wonderful the other day, I could smell it from a mile away...
Need anything special today? Or just the usual stock?
@i! What do I have the pleasure for today?
Veronica is a tough one, I really struggle with talking to the quieter ones...
I have no idea how Aiden stays in business with all these handouts.
Keep people wanting! Or they'll never come back!
I've heard a lot of stories, but nothing about Haruna's homeland, how strange.
I always love chatting with Evelyne! When she's awake of course...
Do NOT trade with those Gnomes!!
Do they even understand how valuable silver is? What am I supposed to do with that stupid dust??
I was hanging out with Leon the other day, what an interesting person!
I wasn't expecting someone familiar with culture to this extent out in a village like this!
I wonder why people find it so difficult to get along with Caroline.
What do you do what do you know, it's @i!
Very rarely do I get to actually explore the towns and cities I've stayed in... Usually I'm tied up in my shop!
Witches are the best, they always ask for the most random things
And who better to aquire said things than yours truely!
Sometimes I wake up in a cold sweat thinking about the time someone served me a plate of Hákarl.
Wish I knew what that was before I hogged it down!
You know I've never actually met the person who makes all your machine upgrades.
They've gone through like 4 different brokers by the time they end up on your farm!
I bet a person like you would love the Camuy Caves!
You just gotta watch out for those stupid horrifying spiders around there. Really don't like those things...
Nobody around here dances which is a bit of a culture shock! I wonder if this is how Haruna constantly feels!
@i @i @i! I've been looking forward to your next visit.
Do you want a drink? Or are you still working? You always work too hard!
Y'know, this place is a lot like home.
So much hustle and bustle... a guy could get comfortable.
Sometimes I feel like I should've collected these things myself.
I've been around, but I've never been in any real danger, y'know?
Oops, carried away again. Did you need anything?
dialog.npc.trader.gift_loved.1.line_0: I love someone that can eat, but I love someone that can cook more!
dialog.npc.trader.gift_loved.2.line_0: You're the best, @i, you know that?
dialog.npc.trader.gift_loved.3.line_0: * You notice the ravenous look on Carlos' face and hand the gift over *
dialog.npc.trader.gift_loved.3.line_1: * There are no words, but the sheer speed of consuption says everything you need to know *
dialog.npc.trader.gift_loved.4.line_0: I'm in awe. This is like...
dialog.npc.trader.gift_liked.1.line_0: You're a sweet one, aren't you?
dialog.npc.trader.gift_neutral.4.line_1: Will this fit in my pack?
dialog.npc.trader.gift_disliked.3.line_1: I kinda thought you knew me a bit better.
dialog.npc.trader.gift_disliked.4.line_0: What am I supposed to do with this?
dialog.npc.trader.gift_hated.1.line_0: I mean, if you want me to go, I can go.
dialog.npc.trader.gift_hated.2.line_0: You're joshing me, right? Yanking my chain?
dialog.npc.trader.gift_hated.3.line_1: Well, I really hate this, actually.
dialog.npc.trader.gift_hated.4.line_0: ... I don't have to be here. Nobody here does. Remember that.
dialog.npc.trader.unique_five_gift.line_: I've done something amazing! Amazingly funny! Nobody's gonna believe it!
I tracked down the supplier for some of the town's accessories, with my amazing talent for acquiring things of course!
Of course I have to be true to my worth, even with someone I adore like you!
I have these up for barter if you want to 'steal everyone's look'!
You're barking up the wrong Quercus.
Flowers wilt, but you will not.
There is an odd stillness in the air around you.
Capital has the ability to subsume all critiques into itself.
Even from the likes of me.
Does that mean one should halt all critique? Perish the thought.
The wind feels nice today. Genuine wind is something your industrial self will never recreate.
The blades of those metallic abominations you call fans will never compare.
The mystery of Selene will never be unraveled. The mysteries of the moon are endless.
I have an interest in that sage of yours, the sleepy unkempt one.
During clear nights I see a glimmer of an eye watching me...
Like a cardinal in spring looks at a fresh berry...
The company of others is to be enjoyed, not shamed. Be kind others as you have I.
When trees drop the canopy flourishes and fungi flounder. The natural Cycle of life in these woods.
A leaf of a weep for all my fallen communion.
A silent blessing upon the evergreens that proceed them.
Why does the oak cherish a voluminous sack of flesh and cartilage?
Capital has the ability to subsume all critiques into itself.
Just like you fell the land, my kind shower those beneath us with darkness.
A shaded death to these desperate flower buds in this sunlit valley.
dialog.npc.wise_oak.unique_five_gift.lin: Hello again soft one. I have been watching you and your little communion you call a town.
There's something to this little society... Much like the forest itself, you and your ilk are just trying to survive in harmony.
The labor is your fruit, something that each one benefits from mutually. No one dominant force to claim ones capital as their own.
Even that purple demon leaves the fruit of your labor to yourself... But I digress.
I wish to participate in this society, but like anyone else it needs to be on my terms as I represent the natural order of things.
dialog.npc.wise_oak.unique_no_gifting.li: Oh soft one, your petty little bribes won't work on me.
My respect cannot be bought, as much as you capitalists wish otherwise.
Earn my respect through conversation and conversation alone.
dialog.npc.goddess.unique_skull_cavern_h: (This has been disabled for performance reasons but can be changed in _config.js)
dialog.npc.goddess.unique_skull_cavern_s: (This has been disabled for performance reasons but can be changed in _config.js)
